method.classes: exclusive; at-least values are sums of disjoint classes
method.geometry: the monitor's full-resolution weekly map from its archive
method.history: One entry for each weekly map, oldest first, each measured from the monitor's archived map of that week. Exclusive class shares are recoverable by differencing the cumulative ones. A week with a null release date was measured after the fact; the archive states no release date.

backfill.note: Every week is measured from the monitor's archived map of that week. Weeks measured after the fact carry no release date because the archive states none. A skipped week is one the archive could not supply; it is left as a gap.

skipped.reason: the archive holds no map for this date
the archive holds no map for this date
